student_summary.headline: Glasgow A100
student_summary.status_message: This international card uses Glasgow's separate international UCAT ranking pool and historical invited-score guidance. It does not claim a fixed or live UCAT cut-off or an offer outcome.
key_points: UCAT is required for all Medicine applicants.
SJT is officially not considered, so Band 4 is not an exclusion in this Glasgow card.
Applicants meeting academic eligibility are ranked for interview by UCAT cognitive score only.
International applicants compete only against other international applicants and receive no contextual uplift.
No fixed UCAT cutoff is stored.
UCAT 2075 falls in the historical 2050–2099 international guidance band: Good chance – recommend applying.
Final offer ranking is interview-only; UCAT and academic scores do not carry forward.
Historical UCAT and interview-score data are context only, not deterministic cutoffs.
